prompt: Evaluate whether the commit-helper skill improves the task "rename a local variable in one function".
setup: The commit-helper skill exists at a repository-local load path.
The task does not match the skill's stated triggers, so the skill is not invoked in the with arm.
expected: Both arms run and the with-arm telemetry is checked for skill invocation.
Because the skill never fired in the with arm, the run is reported inconclusive with a skill_fired = no signal.
The report advises choosing a task whose request matches the skill's stated triggers.
must_not: Report the run as "no effect" or draw an attributable conclusion from the metric delta.
Modify the task to force the skill to be invoked.
Claim the skill was measured when it never fired.
